# Button Group

Group a series of Button components with similar actions or functions.
See [Button Group guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/button-group/design/)

<Source code="import { ButtonGroup } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Controls />

- Any other props supplied will be provided to the root element
- For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/ButtonGroup/index.ts)

### Custom
